institution: The University of Texas at Dallas
notes: Application fee is $75 for graduate applicants.

app_fee.value: Application fee of $75 for all graduate applicants unless fee waiver applies.
app_fee.quote: All applicants are required to submit a $75 application fee within the application or Applicant Portal, unless you meet one of the fee waiver criteria below. The application fee is non-refundable.

fee_waiver.value: Application fee waivers available for eligible participants in select programs; limited to U.S. citizens or permanent residents.
fee_waiver.quote: To qualify, students must be applying for a PhD or master’s degree at UT Dallas. Non-degree applicants are not eligible for fee waivers. Only U.S. citizens, or permanent residents, are eligible to request a fee waiver.

gre_general.value: GRE or GMAT score required only if applicable by program.

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT score of 80 for tests taken on or before January 26, 2026 (or 4 on new scale).
toefl_min.quote: Test of English as a Foreign Language iBT (Internet-based test) Minimum score: 80 (for tests taken on or before January 26, 2026)

ielts_min.quote: International English Language Testing System, Academic (IELTS) Minimum score: 6.5

english_waiver.value: Exempt from English exam if degree earned through instruction and examination in English.
english_waiver.quote: Your bachelor’s or master’s degree (or its equivalent) was earned through instruction and examination in English.
